Case: Huong is a 45-year-old with hepatocellular carcinoma status-post C4-C5 corpectomy and fusion 8 months ago who presents with new arm and leg pain. Of note, Huong endorses unintentional weight loss over the last 2 months which coincided with increased severity of her pain. Tylenol and ibuprofen have not been effective, and Huong is due to revisit her oncologist since completing her last radiation treatment. MRI of scans of her entire spine show increased tumor burden in her lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding her peritoneum.
